args.title: AC-1 Each product in the list shows a picture, and no two products show the same picture
args.steps:
1. Navigate to the sign-in page|Sign-in page is shown
2. Enter credentials for standard_user and click Login|Products page is displayed
3. Observe all product images in the list|Every product has an image that is visible
4. Check that no two product images share the same src attribute|All product image src values are unique (D15: functional equivalence-partitioning)
5. Sign out and sign in as problem_user|Products page is displayed
6. Check all product image src values for the problem user|Every product image src is unique; if all show the same src, this confirms bug #121 is still active (D16: confirmation, expected to fail while bug #121 is Active)

args.title: AC-2 A product's picture on its own page is the same as in the list
args.steps:
1. Navigate to the sign-in page|Sign-in page is shown
2. Enter credentials for standard_user and click Login|Products page is displayed
3. Record the src attribute of the first product's image in the list|Image src value is captured
4. Click the first product's name to open its detail page|Product detail page is shown
5. Compare the image src on the detail page to the recorded list image src|The src values are identical — the same image is used in both places (D17: functional state-transition)

args.title: AC-story Product images pass accessibility checks
args.steps:
1. Navigate to the sign-in page|Sign-in page is shown
2. Enter credentials for standard_user and click Login|Products page is displayed
3. Run axe-core accessibility scan on the inventory container with WCAG 2.0 A and AA rules|No axe violations are reported — violations list is empty (D18: accessibility checklist-based)
